facts.business: Mid East Portfolio Management Ltd operates in the capital market segment providing financial services.
key_risks: Increasing competition in the capital market and financial services sector
Changes in regulatory and compliance requirements
Volatility in capital markets and economic conditions
Attraction and retention of skilled and qualified human resources
Changes in government policies, taxation and other applicable regulations
facts.related_party_note: The Company has one Joint Venture and does not have any subsidiaries or associates. No loans or advances in the nature of loans have been granted to the Joint Venture during the year. The Company has granted unsecured loans to various companies, firms, and other parties. Aggregate amount of loans or advances during the year amounts to Rs. 2,26,50,000 and balance outstanding at the balance sheet date amounts to Rs 3,82,40,477 with respect to such loans or advances and guarantees or security to parties other than subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates. Loans or advances in the nature of loans either repayable on demand or without specifying period of repayment aggregating to Rs. 24,90,000.
